FOLLOW_PLAN.INTRO: If they stop answering mid-conversation, the same agent reaches out again. This is what will happen:
FOLLOW_PLAN.NUDGES: Reminders within 24 h (WhatsApp allows free text)
FOLLOW_PLAN.NUDGES_2: 2: 2 h and 20 h after their last message
FOLLOW_PLAN.TEMPLATES: After 24 h (approved templates only), sends these, one at a time:
FOLLOW_PLAN.NO_TEMPLATES: After 24 h WhatsApp only allows approved templates; your inbox has none (or the agent has no WhatsApp inbox).

NUDGE.prospects: reminder: picks up the pending question
NUDGE.customers: reminder: picks up what's pending or asks if it was solved
NUDGE.campaign_seller: reminder: picks up their question or the offer
NUDGE.collections: Reminds them of the pending payment or the date they were going to give

END.prospects: marked «no answer»; if they answer, the agent picks it up
END.customers: if a solution was given: «solved, unconfirmed»; if data was missing, hands it to the area team
END.campaign_seller: marked «no answer»; if they answer, the agent picks it up
END.collections: Ends without reply (the next collection reminder follows «When it collects»)

FOLLOW_PLAN.HINT: If they answer, it starts over from their new message. If qualified, discarded or handed to a person, it doesn't write. Each conversation shows the next reminder and lets you cancel it.

FOLLOW_UP.TEMPLATES: After 24 hours (WhatsApp only allows approved templates), sends these templates, one at a time:
FOLLOW_UP.HINT: If they answer, it starts over from their new message. If they were qualified, discarded or handed to a person, it doesn't write. If they answer after the last reminder, the agent picks it up.

QUESTIONS_LIST.SUGGEST_HINT: Based on «Your business». Edit them as you like.
QUESTIONS_LIST.SUGGEST_ERROR: Couldn't suggest them now; try again.
QUESTIONS_LIST.SMART: It does not ask what the prospect already said (even in passing). For a question that only applies sometimes, add the condition in brackets at the end, e.g. «How many employees? [solo si es empresa]».
QUESTIONS_LIST.PLACEHOLDER: Write the question as you want it asked
QUESTIONS_LIST.EMPTY: Without questions it will only ask what they're looking for.

TALK.WELCOME_PLACEHOLDER: E.g. Hi! I'm Ana from Autos Guadalajara, thanks for writing 🚗
TALK.WELCOME_HINT: Goes as-is at the start of its first reply, in the same message: then it answers what they asked and continues with question 1. Better without a question at the end (your list asks); if it ends with a question and the customer only greeted, that first message skips question 1. Without it, it greets in its own words.

doubts.QUESTION: If the customer asks something instead of answering:
doubts.answer: It answers with what it knows and goes back to the pending question
doubts.defer: It doesn't answer questions: says an advisor will help and keeps asking (searches no source)

not_found.QUESTION: If it searches and can't find the answer:
not_found.advisor: It says it doesn't have that info, an advisor will confirm it, and keeps asking
not_found.silent: It says it doesn't have that info and keeps asking (no advisor promised)

off_topic.QUESTION: If they write something unrelated to your business:
off_topic.redirect: It politely brings them back and keeps asking
off_topic.answer: It answers in 1–2 lines (without searching your sources) and keeps asking

TALK.ONLY_IF_ANSWERS: Only applies if it answers questions (first option above).

human.QUESTION: If they ask to talk to a person:
human.finish_first: It asks to finish the remaining questions (2 at most) and hands off; if they insist or get upset, it hands off right away
human.now: It hands off right away: it pauses and assigns to whoever you chose in «When qualified»

SUPPORT.ACTION: If it can't be solved with what it knows

ACTIONS.case: Opens a case and gives the ticket number
ACTIONS.handoff: Hands it to a support person
ACTIONS.visit: If it can't be solved here, books a technical visit

SUPPORT.DETAILS: Before opening the case, asks since when it happens or how many are affected (a single question)
SUPPORT.VISIT_HINT: Asks for the address and, if possible, a photo of the equipment; offers times from whoever you choose and books the visit (for on-site businesses: AC, installations…).
SUPPORT.SEVERITY: Priority is automatic: can't operate → urgent (opened right away); works with a failure → high; how-to → medium.
SUPPORT.DEFAULT_SERVICE: If the customer doesn't say which equipment, product or service, assume
SUPPORT.DEFAULT_SERVICE_HELP: Just a frame of reference: the AI decides which module it is with your Affected services (Cases › Classification) and, if not said, uses this one. The case gets that service and its category.
SUPPORT.EVIDENCE: Answers only with what your sources say: with an exact solution it gives the steps as written, with links, and closes with RESUELTO / ESCALAR; if it is for another system it says so; if several apply it asks which; if nothing, it says so and hands it over. Each conversation gets labels showing how it was classified (#soporte-falla, #respondida, #canalizada…).

quote.LABEL: Quote, buying or talking to a salesperson
quote.opportunity: Creates the opportunity for the salesperson

demo.LABEL: If they ask for a demo

visit.LABEL: If they ask for a salesperson visit

booking.LABEL: If they want an appointment for a service (salon, clinic, workshop…)
booking.handoff: It is logged and someone confirms it
booking.appointment: Books it with the duration of each service
booking.HINT: Asks which service they want, finds a time in the calendar of whoever you choose below (or whoever they ask for), and the appointment lasts the «Duration» of each service in the Catalog (no duration: 30 minutes).

SALES.EVIDENCE: It only states what your sources confirm; the rest it says it can't confirm. It never offers a demo instead of a visit.

ADMIN.CASE: Opens an admin case (otherwise hands it to the person or team)
ADMIN.NO_SOURCES: It doesn't search your sources or give balances: it asks what's missing in one question and hands it over.

CUSTOMERS.KNOWS_HINT: Sales and Support search here; Admin doesn't.
CUSTOMERS.SUGGEST_EXAMPLES_HINT: Replaces the yes/no examples of the enabled areas with ones using your business vocabulary («Your business»).
CUSTOMERS.SUGGEST_ERROR: Couldn't build them now; try again.
CUSTOMERS.WELCOME_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Hi! I'm Sofi, from customer care.

human.LABEL: If they ask to talk to a person
human.understand_first: First asks what they need, to hand them to the right team (recommended)

not_client.LABEL: If the person writing is not a customer
not_client.handoff: Hands them to the person or team below without serving them

identify.LABEL: If we don't know their company
identify.ask: Asks once which company they write from and their email, and links them to their organization (recommended). From a company email it links them by domain on its own

TALK.MULTI: If they ask for several things, it handles them one by one; anything pending goes in the note when it hands over.

CUSTOMERS.GENERAL_USER: What belongs to no area goes to

MATRIX.TITLE: Test the matrix
MATRIX.HINT: Runs every «yes» and «no» example of your areas and tells you if it landed where it should.

CUSTOMERS.TEST_HINT: Write as your customer: «I can't log in», «I want a quote», «my invoice has the wrong tax ID»…

RULES.LABEL: Rules for this area (optional)

PLACEHOLDER.support: E.g. Before giving steps, confirm they have the latest version.
PLACEHOLDER.sales: E.g. Never offer discounts; prices already include VAT.
PLACEHOLDER.admin: E.g. Invoices can only be corrected within the same month.
PLACEHOLDER.other: E.g. Ask for their order number before handing over.

RULES.HOURS_HINT: Outside those hours, it takes what they need and says the team will write as soon as it opens. Without hours, it always serves the same.

CUSTOMERS.QUOTE_NEEDS_SALES: It only quotes when the Sales area is on (in «What it handles»).
CUSTOMERS.QUOTE_HINT: When the customer asks Sales for a quote and the products and quantities are known, it builds it with Catalog prices.

GOAL.LABEL: What should it achieve?
GOAL.HINT_none: Answers, solves and routes; doesn't push anything.
GOAL.HINT_appointment: After giving information it invites once to book («Shall I find a time?»). If they say no it stops; once booked it only moves or cancels. Never in support, admin, complaints or when they ask for a person. Needs appointments on in Sales.
GOAL.HINT_quote: After giving information it invites once to get a quote. If they say no it stops. Needs «Quotes» on.

CAMPAIGN.SUBTITLE: Knocks on the door in your campaigns: the campaign sends the first message and it follows up when they reply. It sparks interest, answers the first questions and hands the interested ones over.
CAMPAIGN.WHERE_USED: It doesn't serve inboxes: you pick it on the campaigns screen, under «What?».

STEPS.talk: How it talks and the handover

STEP_HINTS.knows: The basics of your business and where it looks up answers.
STEP_HINTS.talk: Its voice (How your company talks), the default relay, general objections, quotes and your free-text instructions (below).
STEP_HINTS.instructions: Anything else it should know or do (optional).
STEP_HINTS.test: The chat starts with the campaign message: reply as your contact would.
STEP_HINTS.files: Ones that work for any campaign: catalog, company deck, price list. Images for one offer (the promo photo, the event flyer) go in the campaign, «Offer» step.
STEP_HINTS.follow: If they reply and go quiet mid-conversation: reminders and timeline; handoff time and appointment reminder.
STEP_HINTS.quote: If they are interested in the offer and ask for a quote, it builds it with Catalog prices.
STEP_HINTS.business: Business details and how it talks: your company's or customized for this agent.

offer.TITLE: Offer
offer.ABOUT: A product, service or promotion. If they're interested, it hands them over.

invite.TITLE: Invite
invite.ABOUT: To an event. Confirms whether they'll come and updates the event list.

reactivate.TITLE: Win back
reactivate.ABOUT: Customers who haven't bought in a while. If interested, it hands them over.

renew.TITLE: Remind or renew
renew.ABOUT: Something expiring (license, policy, service). If interested, it hands them over.

survey.TITLE: Survey
survey.ABOUT: Up to 3 satisfaction questions. A low score opens a case.

CAMPAIGN.NO_EVENTS: No upcoming events: create one in Events.
CAMPAIGN.INVITE_WHAT: What to tell them about the event (optional)
CAMPAIGN.OFFER_DETAILS_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. 20% off if you sign up before November 30

PLACEHOLDERS.offer: e.g. Training for your sales team
PLACEHOLDERS.invite: e.g. Live demo and coffee break
PLACEHOLDERS.reactivate: e.g. We miss you: 15% off your next purchase
PLACEHOLDERS.renew: e.g. Your license expires this month; renew at the same price

SURVEY.QUESTIONS: The questions (up to 3, asked as written and in order)
SURVEY.PLACEHOLDER_1: From 0 to 10, how likely are you to recommend us?

CAMPAIGN.RELAY: Default relay: the interested contact goes to (each campaign can change it)

RELAYS.agent: The inbox agent: «Prospect care» (or «Customer care» if already a customer). If none, the person or team below.
RELAYS.person: The person or team below (if the campaign has a handover board, it goes there with its deadline)

CAMPAIGN.RULES: Always: one question per message; if they say no, it says goodbye without insisting; «stop messaging me» opts them out; it never makes up prices or dates.
CAMPAIGN.OBJECTIONS: General objections (for every campaign; offer-specific ones go in the campaign)

OPENERS.offer: Hi! I'm writing about this: {what}. Want to hear more?
OPENERS.invite: Hi! You're invited to {event}. Shall we save you a spot?
OPENERS.reactivate: Hi! It's been a while: {what}. Interested?
OPENERS.renew: Hi! A reminder: {what}. Shall I help you renew?
OPENERS.survey: Hi! Could you spare a minute for a short survey?

CAMPAIGN.QUOTE_NOT_FOR_PURPOSE: Invite and Survey campaigns do not quote.
CAMPAIGN.QUOTE_HINT: If they are interested in the offer and ask for a quote, it builds it with Catalog prices.
CAMPAIGN.TEST_IN_CAMPAIGN: «{name}» is ready. To test it, create or open a campaign and in «Review and launch» use «Simulate the campaign», «Chat with the seller» or «Real test»: that is where it is tested with the real offer.
CAMPAIGN.APPOINTMENT_HINT: When a campaign's goal is «Book an appointment», the seller books on these people's calendars.
CAMPAIGN.EMAIL_SIGNATURE_PLACEHOLDER:
Ana López · Sales
Grúas del Norte · 81 1234 5678

FILES.HINT: Upload images or files the agent can send (product photos, flyer, catalog, map…). Give each one a description: the agent can't see the image, so that's how it knows when it helps and doesn't make up what it shows.
FILES.FIRST_MESSAGE: The image in the campaign's first message goes in the WhatsApp template (Settings › WhatsApp templates, image header). Here go the ones it sends afterwards.
FILES.ABOUT_PLACEHOLDER: What it is (e.g. photo of the Basic package with its price)
FILES.ABOUT_MISSING: Without a description the agent doesn't know when to send it.

WHEN.ask: When they ask or it helps

FILES.PENDING: Uploads when you save the agent
FILES.LIMITS: At most 2 per message and never repeats one unless asked. WhatsApp accepts JPG or PNG images up to 5 MB, video up to 16 MB and PDF up to 100 MB. On a touch it only goes out if the 24 h window is open.
FILES.IMAGE_TYPE: «{name}»: the image must be JPG or PNG.

AGENT_VOICE.TITLE: How this agent talks
AGENT_VOICE.MODE_COMPANY: Use the company's (How your company talks)
AGENT_VOICE.HINT_COMPANY: Uses «How your company talks»: if you change it there, this agent changes too.
AGENT_VOICE.HINT_OWN: Only for this agent: starts from the company's and you change what you want. It no longer follows company changes. Going back to «Use the company's» removes the customization.
AGENT_VOICE.EMPTY: Your company hasn't filled it in yet: do it in «How your company talks» or customize it here.
AGENT_VOICE.EDIT_COMPANY: Change it in «How your company talks» ↗

AGENT_BUSINESS.TITLE: Business details
AGENT_BUSINESS.MODE_COMPANY: Use the company's (How your company talks)
AGENT_BUSINESS.HINT_COMPANY: Uses what you sell, to whom, where, why choose you and prices from «How your company talks»: if you change them there, this agent changes too.
AGENT_BUSINESS.HINT_OWN: Only for this agent: starts from the company's and you change what you want (e.g. another product line). It no longer follows company changes.
AGENT_BUSINESS.EMPTY: Your company hasn't filled them in yet: do it in «How your company talks» or customize them here.
AGENT_BUSINESS.EDIT_COMPANY: Change them in «How your company talks» ↗

COLLECTIONS.SUBTITLE: Writes to customers with a balance (from your receivables in Sales › Collections), gives the summary and payment details, records payment promises and proofs, and hands off what needs a person.

HINTS.agent: Its name and who gets customers that need a person (if the receivables don't name a collector).
HINTS.business: Business details and voice: your company's or customized.
HINTS.channel: Where it collects: WhatsApp (one approved template per stage) or email.
HINTS.rules: At what time, how often and how many customers per day.
HINTS.pay: What it gives the customer when they ask how to pay, as is.
HINTS.follow: If they reply and go quiet mid-conversation: the reminders.
HINTS.test: Test with a customer from your receivables (the first with a balance, as an example).

COLLECTIONS.NAME: Agent name
COLLECTIONS.COLLECTOR_HINT: If the receivables have a Collector column, each customer goes to theirs.
COLLECTIONS.CHANNEL_PICK: Pick a WhatsApp or email inbox
COLLECTIONS.TEMPLATES_HINT: WhatsApp only allows writing first with an approved template. Use balance variables: {{cobranza_saldo}}, {{cobranza_vencido}}, {{cobranza_facturas}}, {{cobranza_dias}}, {{cobranza_vence}} and {{nombre}}.
COLLECTIONS.NO_TEMPLATE: No template (not contacted at that stage)
COLLECTIONS.NO_TEMPLATE_HINT: A stage without a template isn't contacted on WhatsApp. Once the customer replies, the agent writes freely with the exact summary.
COLLECTIONS.OUTREACH_HINT: Off, it only answers whoever writes. On, it writes to whoever is due by these rules.
COLLECTIONS.EVERY: For those still owing, writes again every
COLLECTIONS.RULES_HINT: It won't write to customers with an active payment promise, a proof pending review, disputed invoices, or someone already handling them.
COLLECTIONS.PAYMENT_PLACEHOLDER:
Bank: …
Account: …
Reference: your customer code
COLLECTIONS.PAYMENT_HINT: Without details, when asked how to pay it hands off to the collector.
COLLECTIONS.INSTRUCTIONS_PLACEHOLDER: E.g. Cash payments are made at the branch. Don't offer payment plans: hand off.
COLLECTIONS.TEST_HINT: Write as the customer: «how much do I owe?», «I'll pay Friday», «I already paid», «that invoice isn't mine».
COLLECTIONS.CHAT_HINT: You are the customer (one from your receivables, as an example). Nothing is saved.
COLLECTIONS.IN_LIST: {n} customers with balance · {contacted} contacted in 7 days
